record.question: The police is entrusted ___ the enforcement of law and order.
record.explanation: Answer B: with. The standard construction is “entrusted with the enforcement” (B). Independent check: “Entrusted with” is the standard construction. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/entrust; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/idiom; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses.
